title: Yellow Umami Korean Tofu Noodles
description: A plant-based friendly Korean dish featuring umami flavors from doenjang and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a post-workout meal

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the doenjang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chopped ferment-kimchi and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add the cubed tofu and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the doenjang and kimchi mixture
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds
